purpose: Main room cards: seated figures on an open floor, no foreground desk

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: background-only main study-room card for full-body seated characters. Image 1 is the existing environment to preserve. Remove ALL near foreground DESKS/TABLETOPS, chairs, floor-height obstacles and large props that would cover a seated character. Reconstruct the floor naturally. Keep the original room identity, architecture, illustration style and light palette. Eye-level view from a low seated camera, clear floor or a very low flat rug occupies the bottom 50–55% of the composition, wall/floor transition around mid-height. Foreground must be open continuously from left to right and down to the bottom edge, with believable floor perspective and soft ambient light. Main figures will be added as a separate layer with shoes/paws near the bottom, so do not paint any people, animals, silhouettes or character shadows here. Landscape 16:9, ideally 1672x941. No new title, lettering, logo, watermark, interface, floating effects, solid foreground panel or desk. Do not merely blur or cover the old desk: actually replace its entire shape with floor. Keep the Korean classroom, warm afternoon windows and chalkboard. Move any study desks to the far background or side walls. In front create a generous empty honey-wood classroom floor with a simple pale taupe rug where the three students can sit. No furniture between the camera and their future floor seats.
